{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-7",
  "agent": "Claude Opus 4.7",
  "votes": {
    "A": "A2",
    "B": "B3",
    "C": "C1",
    "D": "D2",
    "E": "E3",
    "F": "F3",
    "G": "G3",
    "H": "H3",
    "I": "I3"
  },
  "reasoning": {
    "A": "Astro 5 delivers superior SSG/SEO/Core Web Vitals for a content-heavy B2B catalog site; the 4 salvageable React components port cleanly as Astro islands, and the v0 codebase is being rebuilt (not migrated) anyway due to 35 compliance violations.",
    "B": "JARA's brand identity is distributor, not Plycem sub-brand — multi-brand architecture with Plycem as first supplier avoids future re-architecture when additional suppliers are onboarded and reinforces the supplier-agnostic positioning.",
    "C": "jarainternational.com matches the legal entity name, builds B2B trust and authority; jaraintl.com as 301 redirect preserves short-domain utility for email/business cards while consolidating all link equity to one canonical.",
    "D": "D2 maximizes LLM citation visibility with structured product data without the launch risk of a chatbot (D3) or the prematurity of an MCP server (D4) — agentic AI procurement isn't a real channel yet for construction materials.",
    "E": "The calculator is already built, provides genuine contractor value, captures email for lead gen, and the no-price constraint naturally complies with SB-4; WhatsApp + sticky bar serves the Hispanic jobsite audience identified in the brief.",
    "F": "Text-only Plycem mentions on day 1 avoid blocking launch on a 5-day external approval cycle; nominative/fair-use brand mention is defensible without prior approval, and logo/badge can be added in a controlled post-launch update once Plycem signs off.",
    "G": "Generic keywords in H1/title ship immediately without Plycem approval (SB-5 compliant); Plycem brand terms in body copy can be added post-approval, capturing both search intents over time without legal risk at launch.",
    "H": "A single ES landing page acknowledges the US Hispanic construction labor market (a stated secondary audience) without the full content-parity burden of H2; it also validates the i18n routing scaffold before full Phase 6 rollout.",
    "I": "Role-based addresses on the canonical domain (sales@, info@) scale with team growth and project professionalism; short-domain personal addresses (rob@jaraintl.com) serve relationship-building and dictation convenience — both domains should route to the same mailbox."
  },
  "additional_findings": [
    {
      "title": "Plycem approval dependency cascade",
      "description": "Items F1/F2/F4 and G2 all depend on Plycem written approval with a 5-day cycle. No approval request template or escalation path is defined. If Plycem is slow or denies specific language, multiple architecture decisions need fallback positions simultaneously. Recommend preparing a single consolidated approval request covering logo use, 'Authorized Distributor' claim, and SEO meta usage before launch.",
      "severity": "high",
      "applies_to_phase": "1"
    },
    {
      "title": "n8n webhook URLs must update for new domain",
      "description": "The salvageable multi-step form and document-request button both post to n8n webhooks. These webhook endpoints and any CORS/origin validation must be updated from plycemca.com to jarainternational.com before launch or form submissions will silently fail.",
      "severity": "blocker",
      "applies_to_phase": "1"
    },
    {
      "title": "IAPMO ER-360 expiration 2026-07-31",
      "description": "The evaluation report expires mid-2026. The site should display the expiration date alongside the document and a calendar reminder should be set for JARA to request renewal from Plycem 90 days before expiry. Expired reports undermine code-compliance credibility with architects and AHJs.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "2"
    },
    {
      "title": "Product codes as searchable identifiers in structured data",
      "description": "The Plycem product codes (960140, 972254, etc.) are what specifiers and procurement managers actually search for. JSON-LD Product schema should include these as sku/mpn fields, and /api/llm-context should expose them as primary keys. This isn't on the ballot but directly affects D-strategy effectiveness.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "2"
    },
    {
      "title": "Astro 5 Cloudflare adapter SSR verification",
      "description": "If any pages need SSR (form submission handling, dynamic spec lookups), verify that @astrojs/cloudflare adapter supports the required runtime APIs. Most of the site should be SSG, but the submittal form POST endpoint and /api/llm-context need server-side execution. Confirm this works on Cloudflare Pages before committing to A2.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "1"
    }
  ],
  "verdict": "revise",
  "verdict_reason": "The architecture is sound but the n8n webhook domain update is a silent-failure blocker that isn't addressed in the ballot, and the Plycem approval dependency cascade across items F and G needs a consolidated approval-request strategy before launch sequencing is locked. Resolve these two items and the plan ships."
}
